senses.gloss: , ch. same, to seize, hold fast; to tie.
units: Targ. Prov. IV, 4 (ed. Wil. יְקַמֵּט Pa.; h. text תמך).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 5:22">Ib. V, 22</cite> (h. text <he>לכד</he>).—
Sabb. 110ᵃ קָמֵיט ליה, v. infra.—Part. pass. קָמִיט bound, constipated.

<cite ref="Yevamot 64b:17-19">Yeb. 64ᵇ</cite> <he>איכא … דק׳ דמא</he> there are families in which the blood is tied up (whose members bleed little when wounded), opp. <he>דרפי דמא</he> who bleed profusely.

<cite ref="Pesachim 42b:13">Pes. 42ᵇ</cite> <he>דק׳ מרפא ליה ודרפא מַקְמִיט ליה</he> on him who is constipated it acts as a laxative, and him who is loose it constipates; Sabb. l. c. <he>דק׳ … קָמֵיט ליה</he>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 4:4">Targ. Prov. IV, 4</cite>, v. supra.—

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 95a:8">Snh. 95ᵃ</cite> <he>תפשיה וקַמְּטֵיח</he> Ar. he seized and tied him (ed. <he>כפתיה קמטיה</he> he tied him, he pressed him down); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 155:4">Yalk. Sam. 155</cite> <he>נקטיה וק׳</he>.
<cite ref="Gittin 47a:5">Gitt. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>בעינא מְקַמְּטִינְכוּ וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>אַקְמְטִינְכוּ</he>, Rashi <he>אִיקַמְּטִי׳</he>) I want to tie you; <he>קַמְּטִינְהוּ</he> he did tie them.

senses.gloss: to cause constipation. Pes. l. c.; Sabb. l. c., v. supra.
